entries.heading: There is hereby appropriated $8,000,000, to remain
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
entries.text:
Sec. 769.  There is hereby appropriated $8,000,000, to remain 
available until September 30, 2018, to carry out section 6407 of the 
Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002 (7 U.S.C. 8107a).
